reason: LLM treatment-fidelity classifier monitored the wrong trace component ('llm' instead of 'llm_service'). The TracedLLM wrapper (component='llm') is never invoked in the _run_raphael() cognitive loop; real LLM calls go through LLMService.run_inference() which traces under component='llm_service'. Every run reported treatment_fidelity.llm = FAIL even though the LLM service was actually invoked. Raw traces remain valid diagnostic evidence but results are not admissible for the final D-6B validation matrix.
